description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM } from a bootstrapped seed_pot.tadah.

evaluations.note: 3 on the reference machine (2026-10-12, 3 repeated runs identical). The WARM start is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 1, the best), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 2-3), and its first step cannot move the point: the line search is not run, and the objective-delta test ends the search ("DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"). Until 2026-10-12 the line search re-evaluated the clamped bound from eval 4 on until MAXEVAL = 30 (28 of the 30 evaluations at RCUT2B = 6.0; a scratch build with other compiler flags ended after the second gradient, at 6; 8 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre).

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: the WARM start is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 1), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 2-3), and its first step cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), after 3 evaluations. Until 2026-10-12 the line search evaluated the bound again: on the reference machine its decrease test failed on rounding-level noise of the warm-started relaxation and it re-evaluated the bound until MAXEVAL = 30, "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached" (28 of the 30 evaluations at RCUT2B = 6.0); a scratch build with other compiler flags accepted the re-evaluation and ended after the second gradient, at 6. evals_tol 30 and both statuses were accepted.
